title: Sri Nagara Rises
source_seed: Seed: Sri Nagara, her city of jewels, and the Chintamani mansion in the kadamba grove (Tripura Rahasya via Wikipedia; Lalitopakhyana, details unverified). Invented symbol: the city is shown as towers of light rising from the water.
logline: Slender towers of golden light rise one after another from the dark water around her lotus until she sits at the heart of a glittering city of jewels.
story: Slender towers of golden light rise one after another from the dark water around her lotus until she sits at the heart of a glittering city of jewels. Seed: Sri Nagara, her city of jewels, and the Chintamani mansion in the kadamba grove (Tripura Rahasya via Wikipedia; Lalitopakhyana, details unverified). Invented symbol: the city is shown as towers of light rising from the water.
loop: The light settles and she rests in the frame-1 smile.
audio: Eerie and solemn: low drone, bowed tone, deep frame drums building faster at the payoff; tempo from the director (rule 8).

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, the tall crown and crescent moon centered and fully framed, full-length framing with a slow pull-back.
shots.action: The dark water around the lotus swells and slender jewelled towers of rose and gold light begin to rise out of it in a ring, growing taller as water streams from their walls. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: The water yields the city; each tower is her domain waking.

shots.camera: The slow pull-back continues at eye level, the crown centered and fully framed.
shots.action: The towers rise to the height of Her crown and thousands of tiny windows light up across them, and bridges of light arc between them above the water while She sits calm and smiling at the center. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: She is the sovereign at the heart of the city of jewels.
